name: Girl
source:
A girl at the school where [url=/c571]Michiru[/url] went to before. [spoiler]She was the best friend of Michiru but committed suicide after getting pregnant with an older man whom she got acquainted through the internet. She wears the same accessory with the one Michiru has on her left arm.[/spoiler]

[From Shiori-chan's review]
